title: RELIFE S.R.L. - Corporate Business Plan v9 (Sintetico)
entity_type: Operating company (asset-light operator) — distinct from property-owning SPVs

revenue_corrected_eur.note_2024: 2024 'Total Revenues' formula is =SUM(B47:B123), which double-counts Interior advisory, Construction monitoring, Marketing advisory, and Pre-opening fee rows (both their city-breakdown detail AND their subtotal fall inside the range). All other years use the corrected discrete-cell SUM. True 2024 revenue is ~€99,450 (22%) lower than reported.

ebit_corrected_eur.note_2024: Using corrected revenue. True 2024 EBIT margin is 24.4%, not the reported 41.3%.

fee_consultant_unmatched_revenue_eur.description: Finance Manager / Marketing & Sales Manager / Digital Marketing cost lines (rows 124-126, e.g. '=40000*0.5') are summed into 'Fee Consultant' and added to Total Revenue, but the matching cost is never included in Total G&A (G&A formula explicitly references rows 132,135,138,145,147,150,170 only). This revenue is recognized at 100% margin with no offsetting expense.

ceo_compensation_eur.note: Flat at €182k through the 3 loss/breakeven years (2024-2026), then grows ~6.5% YoY through 2031 — nearly double by 2031.

accommodation_fee_per_bed_eur.description: 'Students accommodation' revenue divided by beds. ~6-10x below GSL-reported gross PBSA rents for the same cities, confirming this line is RELIFE's operator/management fee on gross rent collected by the property-owning SPV, not gross rent itself.
accommodation_fee_per_bed_eur.implied_fee_pct_of_gross_rent: 9-12%, assuming Turin gross rent of ~€7,500-9,500/bed/yr (mid-market, below GSL's €1,200/mo 'prime' Turin benchmark) — consistent with industry-standard 8-12% PBSA management fee contracts.

market_benchmarks_used.asset_light_operator_ebitda_margin_at_sc: 40-55% typical for mature branded hotel/residential operators (Accor/IHG-style); RELIFE projects 65-75% by 2029-2031, which is above typical mature-operator range
market_benchmarks_used.pbsa_real_estate_portfolio_transactions_: Nido/Livensa: EUR 1.2bn for ~9,000 beds (~EUR133k/bed) — a real-estate (NAV) transaction, NOT a comparable for valuing RELIFE as a pure management platform
